department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project)
benefit: If you are hurt in a road accident in Tamil Nadu, you get free (cashless) emergency care in the first 48 hours. You get it even if you do not have a CMCHIS card. It is given only in hospitals that are part of the scheme. The 2022 order set the limit at Rs 1,00,000 per person. A later order (G.O. 419) raised this limit, and the scheme is extended for 2025-2027.

other: You were hurt in a road accident inside Tamil Nadu.
People from other states and foreigners are also covered.
It does not cover assault, injuries at home, falls from height, train accidents, animal bites, self-harm, work-place injuries, burns or cracker blasts.

how_to_apply: You do not need to apply. Go to (or be taken to) a hospital that is part of Nammai Kaakkum 48. Treatment is cashless.
where_to_apply: Government and private hospitals listed under Nammai Kaakkum 48 (many are along highways).
go_number: G.O.(Ms) No.46, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated 03.02.2022
